$comment: How LCM 3D Navigation AI compares with other Unreal Engine 5 3D navigation options. Every cell about another product comes from its own page (sources), read on the date below; 'Not documented' means the vendor does not say, not that the feature is missing. Feeds /unreal-engine-3d-pathfinding-plugins-compared/ and llms.txt (tools/site/pages.mjs, tools/site/seo.mjs). Re-check before each release.

cells.licence: One-time purchase on Fab, full C++ source
cells.worlds: Infinite streamed chunks, pre-baked chunks, World Partition
cells.moving: Restamps the octree; Fly To predicts movers and times its pass
cells.gpu: Yes, on D3D12, D3D11 and Vulkan, checked on each machine

products.name: Mercuna 3D Navigation
products.fit: A studio that wants commercial middleware with a support contract.

cells.price: £2,500 Indie (budget under $500k, Windows only, no source) · £15,000 Standard
cells.licence: Per title, with 1 year of support
cells.moving: Obstacle component; volumes rebuild at runtime

products.name: Flying Navigation System
products.fit: A single, bounded level where a low price matters most and agents use the stock Move To.

cells.worlds: One octree per level; no level streaming
cells.bt: Works with the stock Move To
cells.multiplayer: Paths solved on the server; navigation data not replicated

products.name: AeonixNavigation
products.fit: A free, open-source starting point for teams ready to build on beta code.

products.name: Nav3D
products.fit: Free 3D A* with chunking for teams who will maintain the code themselves.

others.name: Havok Navigation for Unreal
others.note: Microsoft middleware with voxel volumes for flying and swimming; $50,000 per Havok product for budgets up to $20m (havok.com/pricing).

others.name: Kythera AI
others.note: AI middleware licensed per title with source; prices are not published, and flight navigation is not documented.

others.name: AeroNav 3D
others.note: Fab, $49.99 / $119.99, UE 5.3 to 5.8: an octree baked inside a volume, Blueprint nodes; runtime rebaking is planned.

others.name: Smart Flying Navigation
others.note: Free on Fab for UE 5.6: an editor-baked octree with A*, Lazy Theta* and ORCA avoidance, Windows only.

others.name: 3D Path Finding
others.note: Fab, $99.99 / $349.99, UE 5.0 to 5.8: a 3D grid with Behaviour Tree support; avoidance is in progress.

others.name: DoN's 3D Pathfinding (DonAINavigation)
others.note: Free (MIT), built for UE4: its last substantive update targets UE 4.19 (2018).

others.name: HyperNav
others.note: A Unity asset, not available for Unreal Engine.
